Company Profile : EMPG HOLDINGS LIMITED 
 
 
 Company name: EMPG Holdings Limited 
 
 Date of incorporation: 17 th January, 2018 
 
 Registered office: Office 26, Level 3, Gate Village Building 10, Dubai International Financial Centre, Dubai, 500043, United Arab Emirates, Dubai 
 
 Type of business: EMPG Holdings Limited is a company incorporated under the laws of Dubai International Financial Centre, UAE , which owns and operates bespoke digital online real estate portals , primarily in the MENA and South Asia regions . 
 
 Directors &amp; Profiles: Gilles Christophe Marc Blanchard 
 
 Blanchard is the Chairman of EMPG Holdings Limited. He is the Co-Founder of Seloger.com, the largest real estate portal in France. 
 
 Afonso de Campos 
 
 Afonso is a Director or EMPG Holdings Limited. Afonso manages and oversees many technology investments on behalf of global investors. 
 
 Nael Kasser 
 
 K asser is a Director of EMPG Holdings Limited. Kasser is a serial investor with many global investments. 
 
 Imran Ali Khan 
 
 Khan is a CEO and Director of EMPG Holdings Limited . He is also a co-founder of property portal Zameen.com , which has become a highly successful enterprise operating across Pakistan .  
 
 Zeeshan Ali Khan 
 
 Khan is a Director of EMPG Holdings Limited. He is also a co-founder of Zameen.com , which quickly gained prominence as the leading property portal in Pakistan . 
 
 Mark Nosworthy 
 
 Nosworthy is a C F O of EMPG Holdings Limited. Prior to this, Nosworthy was a part of Clicksco Group in the Middle East.
